pending_blockers.detail: After the startup loop, reading stops throughout Ensure and BeforeModelTurn. Buffered()==0 checks only prefetched bytes. Delayed diagnostics, duplicate responses, server requests or a partial frame can already be queued before prompt admission without invalidating the run. The cancel/intent check is also followed by unlocked file creation/fsync before the actual write.
pending_blockers.counterexample: Fake child sends valid id2+thread/started, then a delayed warning or server request while BeforeModelTurn is blocked; callback succeeds and turn/start can be written before the next read observes the error. Cancel after line413 during intent IO also has no final admission recheck.
pending_blockers.minimal_fix: Maintain sticky capture/protocol state during callbacks; synchronize actual-pipe pending-byte/read handoff with a final admission check after durable intent. Serialize cancellation/error/one-use write admission, while cancellation can still close stdin/stop Job if a write blocks. Original arg0 warning ordering is strong but does not replace live protocol fencing.
pending_blockers.required_check: Registered fake OS-child delayed-warning/request/partial-frame and cancel-during-intent cases must prove no prompt bytes; do not infer zero bytes from missing intent file alone.

pending_blockers.detail: Capture exists only in bytes.Buffer and is returned at defer; no bounded durable partial capture or terminal receipt is written. Hard stop loses diagnostics already read. A ReadSlice that crosses the 8MiB limit is consumed but discarded before raw.Write, losing that observed line; the ceiling is checked after ingestion.
pending_blockers.counterexample: Host stops while a callback waits after Native warning bytes were received, or the next line crosses captureLimit; no durable record of those already-observed bytes is guaranteed.
pending_blockers.minimal_fix: Use the established restricted run directory for bounded incremental raw capture and phase/partial metadata; sync before barrier/callback and preserve a bounded offending prefix on limit. Enforce ingestion budget at the reader boundary, distinguish partial/complete, fail closed on IO errors. Persist terminal receipt before Wait returns.
pending_blockers.required_check: Pure/fake capture pressure, write/sync failure, frame overflow and externally stopped fake-host evidence retention; no Native invocation.

pending_blockers.detail: json.Valid/encoding/json do not require valid UTF-8 in strings; no utf8.Valid check exists. Frames are not classified as mutually exclusive response/request/notification. A nonnumeric id is treated as absent, and mixed method/result/id envelopes can be accepted by a matching branch.
pending_blockers.counterexample: Valid id2 policy response with invalid UTF-8 in ignored metadata passes after replacement; a string-id frame using method thread/started can be treated as a notification, although it is a request envelope.
pending_blockers.minimal_fix: Reject invalid UTF-8 before JSON decoding; strict envelope classifier must distinguish key absence from wrong id type and reject mixed method/result/error forms, malformed errors and unexpected root keys according to pinned schema.
pending_blockers.required_check: Invalid UTF-8, noninteger/string/null IDs on notifications, mixed request/response and duplicate keys at all levels are zero-turn failures.

pending_blockers.detail: thread/start explicitly sends environments:[], selecting an empty list rather than the reviewed normal local FromThread default. Official thread_processor unwrap_or_else and thread_manager Option resolution retain Some(empty); core collects no environment selections.
pending_blockers.counterexample: The fake server ignores environments and returns a successful response, hiding that the actual Native route has no selected local executor. This does not implement the contract's local execution route.
pending_blockers.minimal_fix: Omit environments for the reviewed normal default-local route, or freeze and review an exact single local FromThread schema. Assert the chosen creation schema in tests and update template hash/seal binding; do not add environment overrides to first turn.
pending_blockers.required_check: Pinned public DTO/source conformance plus fake child assertion must distinguish absent from explicit empty; real Native validation remains separately authorized.

pending_blockers.detail: After the first turn/completed, the deferred drain appends bytes without parsing them. A later error, duplicate completion, wrong-thread event or incomplete frame can remain in a COMPLETED result. Item IDs/lifecycle are not tracked: an uncompleted commandExecution start, empty/missing agent text, duplicate item completion or changed item identity need not prevent success.
pending_blockers.counterexample: Valid turn acknowledgement/start/completed followed by a protocol error or partial JSON retains COMPLETED if raw drain fits; commandExecution started without completed plus turn/completed also passes.
pending_blockers.minimal_fix: Keep terminal success provisional until bounded shutdown/drain validation; retain sticky errors and validate allowed terminal frames. Track exact item IDs/type/lifecycle and validate final assistant payload and tool outcomes; do not allow later turn/completed to erase a prior incomplete/failed tool.
pending_blockers.required_check: Terminal-tail error/truncation/duplicate cases, missing tool completion, duplicate/mismatched item IDs and malformed assistant text must not return successful completion.

pending_blockers.detail: The RPC path emits CodexEvent.Kind ASSISTANT instead of the shared existing ASSISTANT_MESSAGE and omits NativeID/tool lifecycle projection. Its allowlist rejects normal v2 streaming agent/reasoning delta notifications; official bespoke_event_handling forwards those. The fake stream is authored to the implementation and does not cover pinned Native protocol behavior.
pending_blockers.counterexample: A normal Native agent-message delta fails after prompt consumption. An accepted completed agent message is passed to domain under a different event kind, so the existing assistant-message contract is not preserved.
pending_blockers.minimal_fix: Implement the bounded pinned-v2 notification subset needed by one normal readonly turn, with exact thread/turn/item binding; public summaries only and no private reasoning exposure. Map final assistant/tool events to existing CodexEvent contract. Keep unknown/permission requests failclosed.
pending_blockers.required_check: Source-derived transcript fixtures including normal deltas, supported user/item lifecycle, command completion, existing event kinds/NativeID; tests must assert DTO semantics, not only callback counts.
